displayNameModal.title: Change Display Name
displayNameModal.body: Meta reviews every new display name (usually 1–3 days). Until it is approved customers keep seeing the current name or the phone number. The name must match your business and follow Meta's display-name rules.
displayNameModal.label: New display name
displayNameModal.sent: Sent — the new name is waiting for Meta's review

registerModal.title: Re-register Number
registerModal.body: Registers this number on the Cloud API again — use it after Meta reports the number as not registered, or after a migration. Enter the 6-digit two-step verification PIN of the number (or choose a new one if it never had a PIN). The PIN is sent to Meta and is not stored here.
registerModal.coexistence: This number also runs on the WhatsApp Business app (coexistence). The app keeps it registered, so it does not need — and must not get — a Cloud API registration.
registerModal.pinInvalid: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
